name: Algonquin HubLine
researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The Algonquin Main Line row P0149 runs onshore from Lambertville to Boston. The HubLine is a separate offshore line across Massachusetts Bay, and no existing row lists Beverly or Weymouth. A Massachusetts coastal zone mapping record from 2008 says the Hubline is about 29.5 miles, built mostly offshore between Beverly and Weymouth, as-built and in operation since November 2003 (per the queue note). An Oil and Gas Journal article from 2002 says Algonquin Gas Transmission, then a Duke Energy Gas Transmission unit, applied to the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission for 30 miles of 24-inch pipe plus a 5-mile 16-inch lateral to Deer Island. The 24-inch figure is the proposed size; the as-built diameter was not confirmed, so diameter is medium confidence. The Deer Island lateral was not confirmed as built. Owner spelling has no exact match in the ownership gazetteer; legal form not confirmed. Route: the Massachusetts coastal zone layer is an as-built GIS trace and could be fetched for a route; not done here. Passes length rule (29.5 mi is over 15.5 mi). Two sources are from the same project but independent publishers.
